His work had a significant impact on the development of economic thought in the region, influencing many subsequent scholars and policymakers.

Coirpre Cromm mac Crimthainn's legacy can be seen in the many empires and civilizations that flourished during the Classical era, including the Byzantine Empire and the Sasanian Empire. His ideas on economic systems and social structures continue to be studied by scholars today.

In conclusion, Coirpre Cromm mac Crimthainn was a significant figure in the history of economics and social science, whose work continues to shape our understanding of the world today.
